audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Crystallize 'rarely lands as punishment' because of Distortion, and refers to LeBlanc as male throughout the full layer.
audit.why: Distortion is a dash ('LeBlanc dashes to a location'), and Crystallize creates impassable terrain that blocks movement — the wall is one of the few hard answers to her entry. Telling the reader the opposite removes the matchup's best tool.
audit.corrected: Distortion is a 600-range dash on 15s at rank 1; a wall dropped on her entry line stops the engage before the Sigil combo starts. The return leg is what you cannot wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'level chart contradicts data: Anivia wins 52.56% but the chart gives LeBlanc 6/7 stages vs 1'. On top of that the two layers disagree at rows 4, 5 and 6 (phases read Skill/Skill/Skill; win reads LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Anivia).
audit.why: A 52.56% Anivia win rate cannot sit under a chart that hands LeBlanc every stage but the last, and no page should render two different answers to the same row. LeBlanc's spikes are real but front-loaded: Sigil at 6s, Distortion ranking 15s to 10s, Mimic at 45s falling to 25s. Anivia's are Lost Chapter, level 6 Glacial Storm and Seraph's/RoA — the item stages are where she takes over.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 LeBlanc (her burst window, through Mimic at 6); rows 5-6 Anivia (first item and beyond). phases[4].side = LeBlanc, phases[5].side = Anivia paired with win[5] = Anivia, phases[6].side = Anivia.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are absent: Ethereal Chains only roots if you stay shackled for 1.5 seconds, and Mirror Image turns her invisible for 1 second below 40% health and leaves a damageless clone.
audit.why: Riot's text for E: 'If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them.' That makes the root optional — walking out of the leash inside the window denies it, and Anivia is exactly the champion who dies to the root, not the chain. Riot's text for the passive means your Q or E can be spent on a copy at the moment you are trying to finish her.
audit.corrected: Walk out of Ethereal Chains inside 1.5s and it never roots. Below 40% she vanishes for a second and leaves a clone that deals no damage — do not spend the stun on it.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere; breakdown.cooldowns carries no numbers at all.
audit.why: Every safe step-up in this lane is defined by a number: Distortion 15s at rank 1, Ethereal Chains 14s, Sigil of Malice 6s (refunded on a kill), Mimic 45s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Concrete numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the loading tip and the do's.
